title: G Cloud Backup
summary: Backup & restore made easy - across all your phones
description:
Back up your phone in minutes – now with AI to explore your data. 5 GB free.

G Cloud backs up your photos, WhatsApp, contacts, documents, and more — and now lets you search and explore everything with AI. Switch devices, recover from loss, or find a single photo from years ago in seconds.

✨ NEW: Ask AI about your backups
Your backed-up data is now searchable. No more endless scrolling.
• 🔍 Smart Search: "Show me beach photos from last summer" or "Find my passport scan." Get answers instantly.
• 👥 Face Grouping: Photos automatically organized by the people in them.
• 💬 Natural Questions: Ask anything about your data the way you'd ask a friend.

What G Cloud backs up:
• 🖼️ Photos & Videos: Keep every moment safe in the cloud.
• 🟢 WhatsApp (media, audio, docs): Back up your WhatsApp content in one place.
• 🎵 Music: Protect the playlists you've built over years.
• 💬 Messages: Save important SMS conversations.
• 📞 Call Logs: Keep a history of who called and when.
• 👤 Contacts: Restore your full contact list instantly.
• 📁 Documents & Files: Secure your work and personal files.

Why 5M+ users choose G Cloud:
• AI-powered search – Find any photo, file, or document by simply describing it.
• Works across Android, iPhone & Web – Access and restore your data from any device.
• One-tap restore – Move to a new phone without losing anything.
• Automatic backups – Set it once and let G Cloud run quietly in the background.
• Custom backup control – Choose what to back up and when, so you stay in control.
• Smart albums – AI organizes photos and videos into albums automatically — and you can find them fast.
• Family plans – Protect multiple devices under one account and keep everyone's data safe.
• Strong privacy & encryption – Your content is encrypted and kept private. AI runs on your data for you only — never sold, never shared.

Perfect for you if:
• You're upgrading to a new phone and don't want the hassle of manual transfer.
• You've lost or broken a phone before and never want to go through that stress again.
• You have thousands of photos and want to find any one of them in seconds.
• You use WhatsApp daily and want a simple way to keep your media and documents safe.
• You want one place to protect your family's phones and memories.

Download today and get up to 5 GB of free cloud storage.
Upgrade anytime for more space and extra peace of mind.

Need help?
For any inquiries, contact: support@gcloudbackup.com
